caption:
Your SAT is in 7 days, so do just 3 things.

1. One full timed practice test in Bluebook. 2. Review every miss. 3. Make sure Bluebook is installed on the device you'll test on: exam setup opens 5 days before the test. Then sleep.

Save this for test week.

youtube.title: SAT in 7 Days: The Only 3 Things to Do
youtube.description: A simple plan for the week before the Nov 7 SAT: one timed Bluebook practice test, review every miss, and make sure Bluebook is installed with a reminder set for exam setup.
